answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 156748 Country: Canada Title: If oil is applied in hair will the wudhu done be valid? Question: If oil is applied in hair will the wudhu done be valid? Answer ID: 156748 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 349/303/L=3/1439) Wudhu shall be valid in case oil is applied on the head, oil on head shall not prevent wudhu to be valid. ولا يمنع الطهارة ونيم ذاب وحناء ودرن ووسخ وكذا دهن ودسومة وتراب وطين ولو في ظفر مطلقاً أي قروياً أو مدنيا في الأصح (در مختار مع شامي: 1/288) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
